transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

I feel like I’ve ruined everything in my life and I don’t deserve to be doing art or working with anyone anymore. I've just let everyone down so badly, and I don't feel like I should even be trying anymore.
How long have you been feeling this way about yourself and your life?

It's been building and dragging on for close to two years now, starting about a year after my divorce. This heavy, deep depression really settled in midway through that first year after the split, and it has been with me for well over a year.
Have you had any periods of feeling significantly better or back to your usual self for more than a few weeks during this two-year period?

I haven't really felt completely back to my usual self, since the heavy depression has dominated most of the last two years. There was just a brief period last summer for a few weeks where my mood lifted and I didn't feel quite as sad, though I was still hearing that harsh voice at night and believed people were blacklisting me.

The presence of residual symptoms even during the brief period of improvement further argues against a single episodic depression and supports chronicity consistent with F33.
